name: Salud O. Carbajal

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FARM, FOOD, AND NATIONAL SECURITY ACT OF 2026
statements.title: FARM, FOOD, AND NATIONAL SECURITY ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Chair, I support unions, but this is about cruelty to animals, and we are trying to justify one good over a lot of evil.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING AMERICAN PROPERTY ABROAD ACT OF 2026
statements.title: DEFENDING AMERICAN PROPERTY ABROAD ACT OF 2026
sentences: Just like I have been willing to call out unfair practices by foreign governments, I have also spoken out when our own government does something similar, including under President Trump, who has imposed blanket tariffs without rhyme or reason, an equally reckless action.
I rise in support of the Defending American Property Abroad Act.
I urge my colleagues to also support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNDERSEA CABLE PROTECTION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: UNDERSEA CABLE PROTECTION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Some of the marine sanctuaries most at risk because of this legislation are iconic spots off the coast of California: Monterey Bay, Channel Islands, and the newly created Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary.
Nowhere is this more evident than in the Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary, a sanctuary that was decades in the making.
First nominated by the Northern Chumash Tribal Council in 2015, the sanctuary became effective on November 30, 2024, after review by Congress and the State of California.
Through this legislation, my constituents and the Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary will lose big.

While there is a 2-year exception for the newly designated Chumash Heritage National Marine Sanctuary, current law requires operators and installers of deep-sea fiber-optic cables to obtain a permit from NOAA and pay fair market fees for use of these areas.
However, I firmly believe that we can find a solution that protects these sanctuary resources and treats all stakeholders fairly.
First, allow an alternative license or permit, but require that the project be compatible with the purpose of the sanctuary.

Finally, my amendment would maintain the status quo and allow NOAA to collect a fair market fee for the use of these sanctuary resources, just like any other public land management agency does for cables that cross their protected lands.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ICE'S HORRIFIC KILLING OF RENEE NICOLE GOOD
statements.title: ICE'S HORRIFIC KILLING OF RENEE NICOLE GOOD

This administration has repeatedly turned official channels of communication into engines of disinformation.
Today, I stand with the people of Minnesota and every community that has experienced ICE brutality. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: Just last week, the administration announced the U.S. would be pulling out of all security assistance programs for Europe, including the BSI.
Cutting off the BSI is a massive gift to Putin.
Deterring a war between Russia and NATO is in our best national security interests.
Mr. Chair, in the spirit of bipartisanship, I rise to speak in support of my colleague from Georgia's amendment to authorize the Baltic Security Initiative.
Mr. Chair, I urge a ``yes'' vote.

We want the best mariners in the industry, and by removing outdated entry barriers, we will help ensure steady, long-term employment opportunities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE ONBOARD VESSELS
statements.title: CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE ONBOARD VESSELS
sentences: As technology continues to evolve and transnational criminal organizations get savvier and more sophisticated with their operations, this levels the playing field and helps the United States hold these unmanned vessel operators accountable.

Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 2351, a bill requiring the Coast Guard to have a substantive policy on treating drug overdoses onboard vessels and also ensuring that the Coast Guard has the legal authority to prosecute certain drug smuggling cases.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to support my colleagues who have worked on this important bipartisan legislation, and I look forward to seeing it passed into law.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MARITIME SUPPLY CHAIN SECURITY ACT
statements.title: MARITIME SUPPLY CHAIN SECURITY ACT
sentences: This is just one example of the type of manufacturing that needs to be brought back to the United States, not through the tariffs that pass along costs to the consumer but rather by working with companies and incentivizing change.

For that reason, I urge my colleagues to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REPUBLICAN BUDGET BETRAYAL
statements.title: REPUBLICAN BUDGET BETRAYAL
sentences: A number of members are going to come to provide testimony tonight about what we perceive is a betrayal of our colleagues on the other side of the aisle of the American people with the recently passed budget resolution that really is going to provide tax breaks to the wealthiest Americans in exchange for cuts in vital, essential programs for working- and middle-class families.
Their budget proposes reckless spending to support billionaires and make everyday Americans foot the bill.
It cuts over $1 trillion, including $880 billion from Medicaid, in order to partially pay for trillions of dollars in tax cuts for the wealthiest people.
Apart from that, it also increases the deficit and the national debt to the tune of $4 trillion.
What happened to fiscal responsibility?
There are 80 million people in this country who rely on Medicaid.
In my district alone, over 236,000 people on Medicaid are at risk of losing their healthcare.
Not only that, but the budget resolution would also go after the Affordable Care Act again, and it is projected to raise annual health premiums by roughly $1,200 for 20 million people.

As inflation continues to grow and threats of trade wars persist, the cost of necessities like groceries, childcare, and housing will continue to increase putting a greater burden on American families.
The reality is that undocumented workers make up 14 percent of construction workers and roughly 42 percent of our agricultural workforce.

On Monday I offered an amendment to the budget resolution so we can move forward the bipartisan Farm Workforce Modernization Act to provide farmworkers with legal status so they can continue to work on our farms in this country.

Not only is this the right thing to do, but providing farmworkers with legal status helps provide stability and keeps our stores stocked with affordable groceries and domestically grown food, also helping American growers.
I call on my colleagues on the other side of the aisle to reconsider this reckless plan that would benefit billionaires at the expense of everyday Americans.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to stand here with my colleagues from the Congressional Hispanic Caucus to call out the partisan Republican budget resolution that passed last night for what it is.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CHAOS, CONFUSION, AND MANUFACTURED CRISES
statements.title: CHAOS, CONFUSION, AND MANUFACTURED CRISES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the American people elected us to ensure their communities are protected, not give billionaires back doors into their personal data.

The self-proclaimed party of law and order is willing to let chaos reign, and thousands of Americans see the funding they rely on to get frozen, their benefits put on the chopping block, and even their jobs eliminated by an unelected billionaire.
We will fight ill-conceived tariffs and plots to raise taxes to pay for tax cuts for the richest people in our country.

I am proud to stand here as vice chair of the New Democrat Coalition to make it clear that we are here, 5 weeks into this new Congress, fighting to end the chaos of this new administration and get us back to what the American people elected us to do: lowering costs, promoting safer communities, and actually governing.
We will fight invasions of our privacy.
Of course, we will fight to deliver what we hear every single day: Lower the costs of living, make our communities safer, and stop the chaos and gridlock.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIX OUR FORESTS ACT
statements.title: FIX OUR FORESTS ACT
sentences: We also know there are solutions that can help mitigate the impacts of wildfires, but apart from this, I also know that we need to act to address the underlying intensity of these extreme weather events fueled by the climate crisis.
Apart from supporting my amendment, I also urge my colleagues to continue to work to find commonsense solutions to act on this crisis impacting so many American families.
